answer_1.quote: In this work, we tackle the news image captioning problem...

answer_2.quote: For the general caption generation quality evaluation, we use the BLEU-4, ROUGE, METEOR and CIDEr metrics.

answer_4.quote: Finally, we conducted a human evaluation through crowd-sourcing on Amazon Mechanical Turk on 200 random image-article pairs sampled from the test set of the NYT800K dataset.
answer_4.guideline: Raters were asked to evaluate separately how well the caption was describing the image, how relevant it was to the article, and how easy to understand the sentence was.
